lines.text: Wait! Why Octopuses Have 3 Hearts and Blue Blood!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why octopuses have 3 hearts!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Two branchial hearts pump blood across the gills and one systemic heart.
pumps to the body using copper-rich blue blood suited for freezing deep oceans.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind 3 Hearts!
